title: Authorization required before a foreign graduate begins a Massachusetts internship
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 8.01(7), before commencing a pharmacy internship in Massachusetts a graduate of a non-approved college or school of pharmacy must hold NABP authorization to sit for the FPGEE issued within the preceding year and must provide a copy of that authorization to the Board along with any other documentation the Board requires.
exam_relevance: Tests the pre-internship gate and its currency window for foreign graduates, which is distinct from the FPGEC certification required later for examination.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

numeric_facts.conditions: issued within the preceding year before starting the internship

common_confusions: FPGEE authorization to begin an internship is not the same as FPGEC certification for examination.
The authorization must have been issued within the preceding year.
verification_notes: Read in the current official Board of Registration in Pharmacy publication of 247 CMR 8.00 on 2026-08-19 during Batch 3 tranche B3-A authoring under Issue #91. A fresh independent legal and full-bank realism audit is still required before release.
